1: // Orbit Dodge game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) {
7:     console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
8:     return;
9:   }
10:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
11:   // Set canvas size to fill its container
12:   const resize = () => {
13:     canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
14:     canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
15:     // Recalculate centre and orbit radius
16:     centre = { x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height / 2 };
17:     orbitRadius = Math.min(canvas.width, canvas.height) * 0.35;
18:   };
19:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
20:   resize();
21: 
22:   // Game state
23:   let centre = { x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height / 2 };
24:   let orbitRadius = Math.min(canvas.width, canvas.height) * 0.35;
25:   const satellite = {
26:     angle: 0, // radians
27:     angularSpeed: 0.0015, // rad per ms
28:     radius: 12,
29:     color: '#00ffcc',
30:   };
31:   const debris = [];
32:   const debrisConfig = {
33:     minSpeed: 0.05,
34:     maxSpeed: 0.25,
35:     radius: 8,
36:     spawnInterval: 800, // ms
37:     lastSpawn: 0,
38:   };
39:   let startTime = null;
40:   let score = 0;
41:   let running = true;
42: 
43:   // Input handling – arrow left/right change angle, up/down change speed
44:   const keys = {};
45:   window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
46:     keys[e.key] = true;
47:   });
48:   window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
49:     keys[e.key] = false;
50:   });
51: 
52:   function spawnDebris(timestamp) {
53:     if (timestamp - debrisConfig.lastSpawn < debrisConfig.spawnInterval) return;
54:     debrisConfig.lastSpawn = timestamp;
55:     const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
56:     const speed = debrisConfig.minSpeed + Math.random() * (debrisConfig.maxSpeed - debrisConfig.minSpeed);
57:     // start at edge of canvas along the angle direction
58:     const startDist = Math.max(canvas.width, canvas.height);
59:     debris.push({
60:       angle,
61:       distance: startDist,
62:       speed,
63:     });
64:   }
65: 
66:   function update(delta) {
67:     // satellite controls
68:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) satellite.angle -= satellite.angularSpeed * delta;
69:     if (keys.ArrowRight) satellite.angle += satellite.angularSpeed * delta;
70:     if (keys.ArrowUp) satellite.angularSpeed *= 1.02; // accelerate
71:     if (keys.ArrowDown) satellite.angularSpeed *= 0.98; // decelerate
72: 
73:     // update debris positions
74:     for (let i = debris.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
75:       const d = debris[i];
76:       d.distance -= d.speed * delta;
77:       if (d.distance < 0) {
78:         debris.splice(i, 1);
79:         continue;
80:       }
81:       // collision detection
82:       const satX = centre.x + Math.cos(satellite.angle) * orbitRadius;
83:       const satY = centre.y + Math.sin(satellite.angle) * orbitRadius;
84:       const debrisX = centre.x + Math.cos(d.angle) * d.distance;
85:       const debrisY = centre.y + Math.sin(d.angle) * d.distance;
86:       const dx = satX - debrisX;
87:       const dy = satY - debrisY;
88:       const distSq = dx * dx + dy * dy;
89:       const radSum = satellite.radius + debrisConfig.radius;
90:       if (distSq < radSum * radSum) {
91:         running = false;
92:         break;
93:       }
94:     }
95:   }
96: 
97:   function draw() {
98:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
99:     // planet centre
100:     ctx.fillStyle = '#222';
101:     ctx.beginPath();
102:     ctx.arc(centre.x, centre.y, orbitRadius * 0.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
103:     ctx.fill();
104: 
105:     // satellite
106:     const satX = centre.x + Math.cos(satellite.angle) * orbitRadius;
107:     const satY = centre.y + Math.sin(satellite.angle) * orbitRadius;
108:     ctx.fillStyle = satellite.color;
109:     ctx.beginPath();
110:     ctx.arc(satX, satY, satellite.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
111:     ctx.fill();
112: 
113:     // debris
114:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5555';
115:     for (const d of debris) {
116:       const x = centre.x + Math.cos(d.angle) * d.distance;
117:       const y = centre.y + Math.sin(d.angle) * d.distance;
118:       ctx.beginPath();
119:       ctx.arc(x, y, debrisConfig.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
120:       ctx.fill();
121:     }
122: 
123:     // UI – score
124:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
125:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
126:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${Math.floor(score)}`, 10, 20);
127:     if (!running) {
128:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
129:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
130:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
131:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
132:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
133:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 - 20);
134:       ctx.font = '18px sans-serif';
135:       ctx.fillText(`Final Score: ${Math.floor(score)}`, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 20);
136:     }
137:   }
138: 
139:   function loop(timestamp) {
140:     if (!startTime) startTime = timestamp;
141:     const delta = timestamp - (lastTimestamp || timestamp);
142:     lastTimestamp = timestamp;
143:     if (running) {
144:       score = (timestamp - startTime) / 1000; // seconds
145:       spawnDebris(timestamp);
146:       update(delta);
147:     }
148:     draw();
149:     if (running) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
150:   }
151:   let lastTimestamp = null;
152:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
153: })();

(End of file - total 153 lines)
</content>
